p1: Her DNA was found at 40 crime scenes, in three countries. Nobody ever saw her face.
Germany, 1993. A woman is found dead. On a cup... a stranger's DNA.
Then the same DNA turned up again. And again.
A heroin syringe. A cookie left in a burgled caravan. Murders. Break-ins.
The papers called her the woman without a face.
In 2007, a young police officer was shot dead. The phantom's DNA was there too.
Then her DNA turned up on a dead man's fingerprints. But the DNA was a woman's.
So police tested the cotton swabs.
The swabs were never meant for DNA. A woman who packed them had touched them.
There was no killer. For 16 years, police had been chasing a factory worker.
And the officer's real killers? A neo-Nazi terror cell... not found until 2011.
